Class BedrockScreenLayout

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.screen.BedrockScreenLayout
public final class BedrockScreenLayout extends Object
Shared frame for Bedrock screens built from Java widgets. The title sits in the top row between Back and the Minecoin balance, content fills the space above the footer, and reserved status lines keep messages off buttons.
